description: Joint-event claim: pays $1 only if A and B both resolve YES.
Divergence claim: pays $1 if exactly one of A or B resolves YES.
Broad event exposure: pays $1 if A or B (or both) resolves YES.
Basket/parlay primitive: pays $1 if at least two of A,B,C resolve YES.
Structured tranche: payout rises 0/.20/.60/1.00 with 0/1/2/3 YES outcomes.
